replication.target_description: Poulter et al. Huang (2014) Replication, retained MTurk sample, Dog, neutral versus cleanliness independent-samples t-test. Preregistration item1 explicitly identifies original Study 2 instructed low response effort condition; no high effort arm.

n.sample_role: Analytic participants, 91 neutral and 108 cleanliness; replication tests only the instructed low response effort design.
n.exclusions: Authors report 403 respondents; removed 6 survey previews, 5 incomplete priming tasks, 85 endorsing fabricated answers, and 107 for vignette time limits; also one participant missing a vignette, yielding 199. The running count jumps from 307 minus 107 to 199; the extra missing-vignette exclusion is listed separately.

notes: Original Table 2 column order: Composite rating, Dog, Trolley, Wallet, Plane, Résumé, Kitten. Replication target established by preregistration x9tq5 item1; all retained participants belong to the low effort replication design. Replication author verdict concerns the overall replication/composite, not a separate narrative verdict for each individual vignette. Replication table contrasts Neutral minus Cleanliness, and printed signs are preserved. No vignette-specific d was printed; the printed unstandardized Mean Difference is retained without conversion. Equal-variances-assumed row selected consistently; alternative Welch row retained in cached primary table transcription.
